name: classList.add()
description: Adds one or more class names to an element without affecting existing classes.
parameters: classNames — one or more class name strings.
notes: Adding a class that's already present has no effect and doesn't create a duplicate.

name: classList.remove()
description: Removes one or more class names from an element.
parameters: classNames — one or more class name strings to remove.
notes: Removing a class that isn't present is a no-op and does not throw.

name: classList.toggle()
description: Adds a class if it's absent or removes it if present; an optional force argument makes it behave as a forced add/remove.
parameters: className — the class to toggle. force — optional boolean; true always adds, false always removes.
returns: true if the class ends up present after the call, false otherwise.

name: classList.contains()
description: Checks whether an element currently has a given class.
parameters: className — the class name to check for.
returns: true if the class is present, false otherwise.

name: classList.replace()
description: Replaces an existing class with a new one in a single call.
parameters: oldClass — the class name to remove. newClass — the class name to add in its place.
returns: true if oldClass was found and replaced, false otherwise.

name: className
description: Gets or sets an element's entire class attribute as a single space-separated string.
returns: A string of all class names on the element.
example: el.className = 'card active'; // overwrites all existing classes
notes: Assigning to className replaces the whole class list at once — prefer classList methods when you only want to add/remove individual classes.
